task: OB-01 held-out validation (historical replay; not live, not for public display)

reportSha256Correction.note: The run recorded the SHA-256 of the Windows CRLF working copy of the month report (the writer used platform newlines). Git stores that file with LF (.gitattributes eol=lf), so the recorded value could not be verified on any other checkout. reportSha256 was recomputed on 2026-10-02 over the LF bytes of the unchanged content, which equal the committed blob. Only this digest and this note were edited; no figure was recomputed.

heldOut.daySelection: Calibration November 2025 and held-out January 2026 were chosen as the most recent whole months with no Jewish public holiday or holiday eve (Sukkot/Simchat Torah ended 14 Oct 2025; Hanukkah 14-22 Dec 2025 and its school break fall between them; Tu BiShvat 2 Feb), no Ramadan/Eid (Ramadan 2026 began about 18 Feb), school in session and the same UTC+2 clock (winter time 26 Oct 2025 - 27 Mar 2026). September 2026 (pilot) is Tishrei holiday season.

method: Every held-out observation is placed against the calibration p10/p50/p90 of the same key. If distributions transfer, about 10% fall below p10, 50% below p50 and 10% above p90. medianAbsErrorSeconds compares the calibration p50 with the schedule-only prediction (0 s delay; scheduled run time for segments) in 10 s bins. publishableKeyMedianShiftSeconds compares held-out and calibration medians for keys with at least 20 held-out samples.
